mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loyalty.point_allocation (id, tenant_id, program_id, member_id, account_id, point_type_id, transaction_ledger_id, asset_ledger_id, reference_allocation_id, allocation_type, amount) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{programId}, #{memberId}, #{accountId}, #{pointTypeId}, #{transactionLedgerId}, #{assetLedgerId}, #{referenceAllocationId}, #{allocationType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{amount})
mapper.select: SELECT asset_ledger_id, COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE allocation_type = 'CONSUME'), 0) AS consumed, COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE allocation_type = 'EXPIRE'), 0) AS expired, COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE allocation_type = 'REVERSE'), 0) AS reversed, COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE allocation_type = 'ADJUST'), 0) AS adjust_debit, COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE allocation_type = 'RESTORE'),0) AS restored FROM loyalty.point_allocation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND program_id = #{programId} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND point_type_id = #{pointTypeId} AND asset_ledger_id IN #{id} GROUP BY asset_ledger_id

SELECT id, tenant_id, program_id, member_id, account_id, point_type_id, transaction_ledger_id, asset_ledger_id, reference_allocation_id, allocation_type, amount, created_at FROM loyalty.point_allocation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND program_id = #{programId} AND transaction_ledger_id = #{transactionLedgerId} ORDER BY created_at, id
